header.lead: Assisted calculations for dosing, infusion, and assessment. Seven essential everyday formulas.

disclaimer.html: ⚠ Assistive calculator — not prescriptive. The results serve as support for clinical reasoning. The final decision on dose, route, and frequency is the responsibility of the prescribing professional. Always check the package insert, the patient's clinical status, and drug interactions.

peso.title: Weight-based dosing (mg/kg)
peso.desc: Calculates total daily dose (and per administration) from the recommended dose per kg.

bsa.title: Body surface area (BSA Mosteller)
bsa.desc: Mosteller formula for body surface area. Standard in chemotherapy and pediatric dosing.

conv.title: Unit conversion
conv.desc: Mass (g/mg/mcg), volume (L/mL), and drops (1 mL = 20 macrodrops = 60 microdrops).

infusao.title: Infusion rate / Drip
infusao.desc: Converts volume + time to mL/h and drops/min (macro = 20 drops/mL, micro = 60 drops/mL).

clcr.title: Creatinine clearance (Cockcroft-Gault)
clcr.desc: Estimates CrCl for dose adjustment in patients with altered renal function. Use actual body weight; in obese patients consider ideal weight. May underestimate in elderly with low muscle mass.

imc.title: BMI (Body Mass Index)
imc.desc: WHO adult classification. Not applicable to pregnant women, athletes with high muscle mass, or elderly >65y.

idade.title: Precise pediatric age
idade.desc: Calculates exact years, months, and days from date of birth. Important for pediatric dosing and vaccine coverage.

errors.dosePesoGtZero: Dose and weight must be greater than zero.
errors.weightHeightGtZero: Weight and height must be greater than zero.
errors.massToVolume: Can't convert mass to volume (concentration required).
errors.volumeTimeGtZero: Volume and time must be greater than zero.
errors.allFieldsValid: Fill in all fields with valid values.
